news.headline: Cloudflare (NET) Stock Trades Down, Here Is Why
news.summary: Shares of cloud security and performance company Cloudflare (NYSE:NET) fell 3.2% in the afternoon session after the company's disclosure of a cross-tenant data-isolation vulnerability in its Containers and Sandboxes products.
